title: MLAG ticket: missing peer link
summary: Repair the missing local peer-link configuration without claiming peer health.
brief: The local MLAG domain CAMPUS, local interface Vlan4094, and peer address 10.255.255.2 are present, but the peer-link configuration is missing. Inspect MLAG and running configuration evidence, then configure Port-Channel100 as the peer link. This lab grades local configuration only: it cannot prove remote-peer reachability, negotiation, forwarding, LACP state, or failover.
hints: Use show mlag before changing configuration.
The peer link is a port channel, not the downstream MLAG attachment.
Do not interpret configured local state as proof of a healthy peer pair.

checks.label: Port-Channel100 is configured as peer link
